title: Tool-instance executable identity
description: ADR-0010 'Tool and image identity'. The image is named by repository plus registry-resolved digest only; there is deliberately no tag field, so a mutable tag such as ':local' or ':latest' is unrepresentable. Which of image_* / executable_sha256 must be set for each executor_kind is enforced by tool_instance_shapes.py.

image_repository.description: registry-host[:port]/path with no tag and no digest suffix. Null for deterministic_python.

image_digest.description: Registry-resolved digest through the B13 adapter. Null for deterministic_python.

executable_sha256.description: Hash of the worker module that is the tool, for deterministic_python. Null for pinned_container.

tool_version.description: Version as reported by the tool itself at run time, never copied from a comment or a tag. Null only when the tool never started.

data_identities.description: Rule-pack / policy-bundle / database / reference-table identities consumed by this instance, each with its sha256. Empty when the tool uses none.

redactor.description: Publication-boundary redactor identity (ADR-0010 G9). Null until V06 lands or for a producer that is not scanner-backed.
